Summary: More than 140 Palestinian citizens of Israel killed this year More than 140 Palestinian citizens of Israel have been killed so far this year, a 12 percent increase from the same period in 2025, according to data cited by AFP from the Abraham Initiatives, an organisation that promotes coexistence between Jewish and Arab communities. Community leaders have repeatedly accused Israeli authorities of failing to adequately investigate the violence.
